book.name: 2 Korin
book.title: A Munaur a Pas ane Pol tetek a tarai Korin

content: Mila titol taum o e God, pa mila nunung mulo, sur gong mulo kibas oros a marmaris ning e God ka saran tari tetek mulo.
Anasa e God i atongi mang,

content.text: “Ning a taem ka sot, a longor u,
Pa ana pukakiar ning a alaun u, a nangan u.” Ais 49:8

content: Oroi, onone, a taem ka sot, onone a pukakiar ning e God i alaun pas mulo.
A aposella la kilang a mamahatla
Bel mila mang sur milar tol ta utna ning ir san alar tik sur gong i tortorot, sakana a taraila lar atong laulau anumila a titol.
A titolla rop ning mila sira toli, i asangani mang mila na tena titol ane God. Mila tur rakrakai ning mila kilang a mamahatla pa a kankanla pa akadikla.
Di miras mila pa di akas mila tingui na rumai a dodot. Di balakut tetek mila pa di lu mila. Mila titol rakrakai, bel mila sira borbor ana moromla, pa mila murak.

Mila tol a totoh a toltol, pa mila titol ana tastasmai. Bel mila sira ngoro tetek a taraila, mila tol ka a wakak a toltol tetek la. Mila titol ana harnangai anuna Talngan Tabu, pa mila titol ana marmaris momol.
Mila atong a momolna, pa mila titol ana rakrakai e God. Mila tong akes a tostos a toltol arlar ana numila a utna na harum ana sot a kumila pa ana kair otleng.

Dingla na tarai la hanrawai mila, pa dingla na tarai bel. Dingla na tarai la atong laulau mila, pa dingla na tarai la atong aleklek pas mila. Dingla na tarai la nuki mang mila a tena asasongola, ika mila atong a momolna.
Dingla na tarai la puai mang belal risamila, ika a risamila i itna ot. Mila milau tar a minat, ika kanet mila laun. Di um mila, ika bel di umkol mila.
Mila bal maris, ika mila sira gas ana pukakiarla rop. Mila kapan, ika mila sira angisngis a galis a tarai ana gongon ana ingun. Bel anumila al utna, ika a ututnala rop anumila.
Mulo a tarai Korin, mila ka warwara momol tar tetek mulo, pa a balamila i bukus ana marmaris tetek mulo.
Mila saran anumila a marmaris tetek mulo, ika mulo ot mulo tong akes anumulo a marmaris kusun mila.
A warwara tetek mulo arlar larning a warwara tetek na natnatukla: Mulor mang sur mila ana balamulo rop.
A tena tortorot gong i bal taum onla ning bel la tortorot
Gong mulo bal taum onla ning bel la tortorot, anasa a tostos a toltol ir bal taum mangasa ana toltol laulau? A talapor ir kes taum mangasa ana mormorom?
E Karisito pa e Satan diar malmaling taum mangasa? Ta tena tortorot ir bal taum mangasa on tik ning bel i tortorot?
A asasongo na godla pa rumai a artabar ane God diar malmaling taum mangasa? Anasa dala ot a rumai a artabar ane God ning i laun. Larning e God ka atong tari mange,
Pa Leklek i atongi otleng mang,

content.text: “Mulor purum kusun la, pa mulor kes masik kusun la.
Pa gong mulo tuk a dur a ututnala.
Pa iau ar gas pas mulo.” Ais 52:11
A Leklek ning i rakrakai kol i atongi mang,
pa mulo na natnatukla, a taraila pa a gurarala.” 2 Sam 7:14
